unit: equivalent days of normalized healthy-area duration lost
domains: Europe and all source environmental-region labels, including unassigned cells
year_pairing: All 30 circular shifts of future-year positions against historical-year positions, with original shift zero retained. These are deterministic sensitivity comparisons, not 30 independent replicates or all possible permutations.
support_comparisons: separately available historical and future seasons
identical cells complete in all 60 seasons and all three climate models for each scenario and future period
interannual_statistics: On identical complete-support cells: 30 annual regional weighted means, mean, sample standard deviation, median, 10th and 90th empirical quantiles, average of the three largest values, and fraction of future years exceeding the historical 90th quantile; thresholds fixed separately within each climate model.
ensemble: Equal three-climate-model means; climate-model min–max ranges kept separate from pairing sensitivity and empirical annual spread.
irrigation_sensitivity: Replace all-wheat production weights by observed SPAM2020 rainfed production weights. This changes aggregation weights only; it does not simulate irrigation or distinguish winter and spring wheat.
missingness: Invalid or nonfinite canopy values remain missing. All-empty domains stay missing, never zero. Coverage denominators include the complete fixed source population.
checks: Cell identity and annual-file hashes; shift-zero regional results against prior published aggregation; analytical invariance under full support; production-weight mass; independent brute-force fixtures.
claim_limits: conditional canopy response, not harvested grain loss
annual damage-tail statistics, not food-production downside risk
no calibration or disease model changed
